scope: Prospective complete ActionBench evaluation design for the unchanged 15 selected candidates. This record fixes scientific coverage and decision rules; it is not a passed method design, dispatch approval, Local receipt or native result.

cohort.family_source_policy: Require a complete source-derived family_by_uid map for all 128 released UIDs. Each family ID is recomputed from a canonical upstream-family basis with pinned source/geometry identities and source refs, followed by independent verified review. UID-derived labels and scorer/candidate outcomes are forbidden family evidence.
cohort.development_exposed: Every UID in the retained exposure record and every UID sharing its reviewed asset family is development-only.
cohort.assignment_rule: Remove exposed families, sort remaining family IDs by SHA256(canonical JSON [split_salt,family_id]), assign first 12 to D1, next 12 to D2 and every remaining family to confirmation. Keep every family wholly in one split.
cohort.confirmation_rule: All remaining reviewed unexposed families; never success-only or result-selected.
cohort.minimum_confirmation_rationale: Fewer than 30 independent confirmation clusters is treated as INCONCLUSIVE because the family-cluster bootstrap cannot support a stable cross-family uncertainty claim at the 99-test adjusted level. The threshold is frozen before family derivation; it is a floor, not a power guarantee, and the precision gate may still block PASS.

criteria.rationale: Absolute thresholds are fixed before candidate results and use the released official leaderboard's task-scale separations: 0.002 separates ActionMesh CD-3D 0.054 from TripoSG 0.056, while 0.004 CD-4D and 0.003 CD-M separate full ActionMesh 0.085/0.153 from ActionMesh --fast 0.089/0.156. They are not the previously rejected unsourced 5%/2% work lines.
criteria.pass_rule: For every indispensable contrast, the multiplicity-adjusted one-sided upper confidence bound is below -minimum_effect on the candidate primary metric. For B_star guardrails it is at or below the metric-specific noninferiority margin. Every required arm and frozen unit must have a valid native receipt; otherwise PASS is unavailable.
criteria.kill_rule: Only qualified complete evidence with adequate precision may KILL the scoped construction or necessity; implementation, input, scorer or coverage failures are INCONCLUSIVE.
criteria.revise_rule: Only a prespecified development-supported child hypothesis may REVISE; create a new reviewed protocol and independent confirmation.
criteria.inconclusive_rule: Any absent scientific input, unqualified arm, missing family evidence, incomplete denominator, insufficient precision or unavailable trusted analysis remains INCONCLUSIVE. Do not reduce coverage or thresholds.

statistics.within_family_aggregation: Equal weight per UID after equal weight per qualified frozen generation seed; frames and scorer samples never become independent units.
statistics.precision_gate: Before confirmation, use D1/D2 family-level dispersion only to report whether the complete remaining confirmation inventory can resolve one half of the fixed primary minimum effect at the adjusted level. If not, retain the complete inventory and predeclare INCONCLUSIVE; never shrink the effect or margin after results.

randomness.pairing: same UID, source bytes, upstream context and generation seed for every arm
randomness.current_source_limit: Current retained producer is qualified only for seed 42. Seeds 314 and 2718 remain mandatory design coverage and require separately versioned source/interface qualification before confirmation; they may not be silently removed.
randomness.selection_use: D1 only selects parameters and B_star. D2 checks transfer and assumptions. Confirmation is locked and never used for tuning.

failure_denominator.policy: Retain every frozen role and unit, including preparation, missing-input, bounds, no-solution, timeout, export and official-scoring failures. Never zero-impute, drop failed UIDs, substitute a successful arm or retry the same scientific attempt.
failure_denominator.pass_completeness: PASS requires valid native outputs for every indispensable role over the complete frozen confirmation inventory. Any missing pair makes that candidate decision INCONCLUSIVE and remains in the failure-rate denominator.
failure_denominator.physical_aliasing: Byte-identical outputs may share one physical scorer measurement only when the alias and digest are frozen; logical roles remain separately recorded.

fairness.b_star_selection: Every declared selectable control other than the B_star placeholder must first pass implementation/native qualification. On D1, select the lowest primary family mean across those controls with a deterministic lexical tie break; B_star aliases that exact role and is frozen before D2. A failed or unavailable strong control blocks weakening B_star.
fairness.information: All arms for a candidate receive the same source video, anchor/context, legal method inputs and no GT/scorer state unless the candidate's development-only estimator explicitly requires labels. Confirmation never fits on GT.
fairness.search: At most two candidate-specific numeric parameters with at most three prespecified development values each; the strongest comparator receives matched parameter, information and time opportunity. Changed search creates a child design.
fairness.cost: Report end-to-end load, capture, solve, export, official scoring, peak VRAM/RAM/disk and failures for every logical arm. Extra shared queries are charged to all compared arms when needed for fair information.
fairness.simple_controls: B0, frozen B_star and every candidate-specific operation-isolating control listed below are indispensable; none may be removed for timing.

resources.host_assumption: one user-stated RTX 2080 Ti; actual UUID/VRAM/CPU/RAM/disk and timing require Local observation
resources.environment: native Conda; no Docker or other container runtime
resources.scheduling: Serial GPU scientific units through the existing single harness; independent admitted CPU preparation may overlap within observed resources. Reporting windows do not reset budget or truncate a complete unit.
resources.calibration: Measure the first admitted complete multi-arm development unit of each distinct cost class and use 1.35 times its observed maximum complete-unit time for later admission. Preserve all arms and scorer settings; if a complete unit cannot fit, do not launch it.
resources.gpu_stop: active; this design and its CPU acceptance do not resume GPU authority
